scope: Independent local source inspection only; no import/execution, server/data/checkpoint/outcome access or watch.py edits

Startup/owner-write failure paths also reach cleanup and retained terminal evidence.

V3 seal, root approval/family release/closure bindings, CPU activation flags, fresh extraction/readout outputs, and exact export/cost bindings match the approved reader interface.

Whole24 scientific/source/job/horizon/selected-hash custody is independently enforced by v3 before predictive access. Only CPU extraction and scalar reporting are launched once; no collector, model forward, new science, selection change or retry.
Existing interpreter/repository/dependency paths and hidden CUDA are used for both stages. Main OWNER records the actual standby source binding.
limits: Source approval is not runtime verification. No current closure, process identity, staged dependency or predictive value was inspected.
